questions.stem: Why must the umbilical cord be clamped and cut after birth?

options.text: To stop the baby from receiving too many nutrients
To allow the placenta to be delivered first
To allow the baby to start breathing on its own
To prevent blood loss from both mother and baby

questions.explanation: The umbilical cord is clamped and cut after birth to prevent blood loss from both the mother and the baby. The baby then relies on its own lungs for oxygen.
